# WhatWillSay (阿緯碎碎唸)

> Blog topics: photography, hiking, DIY, product reviews.
> Primary language: zh-TW.

## Canonical site
- https://www.whatwillsay.tw/

## Preferred crawl scope
- Prefer post detail pages for retrieval and citation.
- Category/tag/pagination pages are navigational and lower priority.

## Citation guidance
- Please cite canonical post URLs from this site.
- Prefer quoting the post description and section headings accurately.
